title: 压缩字符串 II
summary: 删除字符串中至多 k 个字符后，按连续字符及频次压缩，求压缩串最短长度。
insight: 记忆化 dfs(index,k) 枚举保留 s[index] 作为下一段字符，并向右统计同字符数 same 与需删除的异字符数 removed；也可直接删除当前字符。
pitfalls: 频次一只写字符不写数字
频次位数在 2、10、100 处变化
可以删除当前字符开启另一种方案

solutions.title: 连续段选择删除动态规划
solutions.idea: 枚举下一压缩段覆盖范围并删除其中异字符。
steps: answer=dfs(index+1,k-1) 表示删除当前；向右枚举 end，same 与 removed
removed<=k 时 cost=1+digits(same)+dfs(end+1,k-removed)，取最小并记忆化

code.java: class Solution { private String text;private int[][] memo;private int encoded(int count){return count==1?1:count<10?2:count<100?3:4;}private int dfs(int index,int k){if(text.length()-index<=k)return 0;if(k<0)return 1_000_000;if(memo[index][k]!=-1)return memo[index][k];int answer=dfs(index+1,k-1),same=0,removed=0;for(int end=index;end<text.length();end++){if(text.charAt(end)==text.charAt(index))same++;else removed++;if(removed>k)break;answer=Math.min(answer,encoded(same)+dfs(end+1,k-removed));}return memo[index][k]=answer;}public int getLengthOfOptimalCompression(String s,int k){text=s;memo=new int[s.length()][k+1];for(int[] row:memo)Arrays.fill(row,-1);return dfs(0,k);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var text:String;private lateinit var memo:Array<IntArray>;private fun encoded(count:Int)=if(count==1)1 else if(count<10)2 else if(count<100)3 else 4;private fun dfs(index:Int,k:Int):Int{if(text.length-index<=k)return 0;if(k<0)return 1_000_000;if(memo[index][k]!=-1)return memo[index][k];var answer=dfs(index+1,k-1);var same=0;var removed=0;for(end in index until text.length){if(text[end]==text[index])same++ else removed++;if(removed>k)break;answer=minOf(answer,encoded(same)+dfs(end+1,k-removed))};memo[index][k]=answer;return answer};fun getLengthOfOptimalCompression(s:String,k:Int):Int{text=s;memo=Array(s.length){IntArray(k+1){-1}};return dfs(0,k)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { string text;vector<vector<int>> memo;int encoded(int count){return count==1?1:count<10?2:count<100?3:4;}int dfs(int index,int k){if((int)text.size()-index<=k)return 0;if(k<0)return 1000000;int& cached=memo[index][k];if(cached!=-1)return cached;int answer=dfs(index+1,k-1),same=0,removed=0;for(int end=index;end<(int)text.size();++end){text[end]==text[index]?++same:++removed;if(removed>k)break;answer=min(answer,encoded(same)+dfs(end+1,k-removed));}return cached=answer;}public:int getLengthOfOptimalCompression(string s,int k){text=s;memo.assign(s.size(),vector<int>(k+1,-1));return dfs(0,k);} };
